text:
Sam: Quick poll — what single snack should we always keep stocked in the kitchen? cast your votes :point_up:
Julia: Dark chocolate. Always. :chocolate_bar: :heart_eyes:
Mike: Granola bars for the chaotic sprint afternoons. low effort, high energy. :muscle:
Anya: Greek yogurt. protein + social brownie points for the person who cleans the spoon. :wink:
Priya: Salted chips. salty snack > everything else. fight me. :fries: :laughing:
Sam: Ok multiple camps forming. making a tiny poll so we stop debating in threads 😂
Sam: ```/poll \"Kitchen snack\" \"Dark chocolate\" \"Granola bars\" \"Greek yogurt\" \"Salted chips\"```
ops-bot: Poll created by Sam — vote using the buttons in the original message. (auto-post)
Mike: also — someone left a note on the fridge: \"Do not eat Anya's leftover cake.\" mystery continues. :face_with_monocle:
Anya: That was a lie. I shared it like a saint. :innocent: but if anyone *did* take it, confess and bring muffins tomorrow. :pray:
Priya: confession: I ate the mango in the top shelf. it was spectacular. :mango: :sweat_smile:
Julia: Mango thief noted. restitution expected in the form of coffee. :coffee:
Sam: Results in an hour, will buy the winning snack for the office. stakes = high. :money_with_wings: :tada:
Mike: If dark chocolate loses I'm initiating a petition. who wants to sign? :raised_hands:
Anya: I'm with you. but also will not stop Priya from stealing your mango again. :rofl:
Priya: trade proposal: mango for a single dark chocolate square. fair? :eyes:
Sam: We have a tie breaker coming. whoever brings snacks next week gets veto power. :hammer:
ops-bot: Kitchen temp log: fridge at 4°C, freezer at -18°C. No alerts. (system)
